caseName: Washington ex rel. McPherson Bros. v. Douglas County
caseNameFull: State of Washington ex rel. McPherson Brothers Company v. Douglas County and Superior Court of Chelan County, Washington
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Peter McPherson for plaintiff in error. Mr. L. L. Thompson for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of §237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
